defs.def: a small plastic object with two or three metal pins, that connects a piece of electrical equipment to the main supply of electricity 插头

ex.s: To make sure your appliance is in fact off, remove the plug from its power supply.
ex.t: 为了确保你的电器确实关闭了，请拔掉电源插头。

defs.def: a small opening in a wall, by which you connect a piece of electrical equipment to the main supply of electricity （电源）插座
a small object that connects a wire from one piece of electrical equipment to an opening in another 连接插头
a thick round piece of plastic, rubber or metal that you put in the hole in a bath/ bathtub or a sink to stop the water flowing out 塞子
a round piece of material that fits into a hole and blocks it 堵塞物；塞子
a small plastic tube that you put into a hole in a wall so that it will hold a screw 螺钉楔子，螺钉塞栓（塞入洞中用来固定螺丝的小塑料管）
praise or attention that sb gives to a new book, film/movie, etc. in order to encourage people to buy or see it 推销；宣传
to fill a hole with a substance or piece of material that fits tightly into it 堵塞；封堵
to provide sth that has been missing from a particular situation and is needed in order to improve it 补足；补充；供给

ex.s: On the other hand, partners can help plug the knowledge or skill gaps.
ex.t: 另一方面，合作伙伴可以帮助填补知识或技能上的缺口。

defs.def: to give praise or attention to a new book, film/movie, etc. in order to encourage people to buy it or see it 推广；宣传
to shoot sb 射击；射杀
to connect a computer to a computer system 把（计算机）联网
to be able to be connected to the main supply of electricity or to another piece of electrical equipment 电器

ex.s: THE BATHROOM • Don’t plug in an electrical appliance or use one while standing in water.
ex.t: 浴室•不要在水中站立时插上或使用电器。

ex.s: “I am pleasantly surprised, because I am always looking for where to plug it in,” Espinoza said before catching the subway in a working-class area of southern Barcelona.
ex.t: “我感到惊喜，因为我一直在找哪里能给车充电，”Espinoza在南巴塞罗那一个工人阶层社区赶地铁前说道。

defs.def: to become involved with a particular activity or group of people 参与；加入
